adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the source-supported champacyclin activity layer, reconciled linked database rows while preserving target/taxon conflicts, and downgraded mechanism claims to biosynthetic/phenotypic context. No blocking local-source gap remains.

materials_exhausted.note: Local source surfaces support percent-inhibition/no-activity rows, database conflict adjudication, and biosynthetic/mechanism context. Missing MIC/MBC/toxicity/direct-MOA values are absent from local material and recorded as nonblocking obtainable-only gaps.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: 21 linked database/literature rows were adjudicated; Pectobacterium/CAMP/dbAMP target mismatches, APD6 Candida overpromotion, and the Mammaliicoccus/Staphylococcus naming mismatch remain explicit cautions rather than hidden conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 9 source-supported rows were extracted from primary prose/methods: one purified champacyclin Erwinia inhibition row, one crude-extract Candida context row, and seven no-detected-activity target rows. No MIC/MBC/toxicity values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: 2 mechanism-context claims were source-located and kept below direct mechanism strength because the paper reports phenotype/biosynthesis, not direct mode of action.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows assign the 25 uM 40% inhibition to Pectobacterium carotovorum; primary source supports Erwinia amylovora DSM 50901.
Primary source supports Candida glabrata inhibition only for crude extracts, not purified champacyclin (1a).
Primary paper names Staphylococcus lentus DSM 6672; linked DBAASP rows use Mammaliicoccus lentus.
Local XML/PDF/supplement sources do not report MIC/MBC, hemolysis, mammalian toxicity, or direct antimicrobial mechanism values for champacyclin.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local primary material reports percent inhibition for purified champacyclin and qualitative/no-detected-activity statements, but no MIC, MBC, hemolysis, or mammalian toxicity value table for champacyclin.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Activity layer records source-supported percent inhibition, crude-extract context, and no-detected-activity rows only; absent potency/toxicity values are not fabricated.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local supplement is a PDF inventory of MS, NMR, hydrolysis, and stereochemistry supporting material; no structured activity/toxicity table is present.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Supplement review supports identity/mechanism context but adds no activity rows.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The packet-linked database sequence snapshot is empty for this DOI, but the primary paper itself gives the champacyclin sequence/stereochemistry and head-to-tail cyclization.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Database rows use primary-source sequence/structure locators; absence of linked sequence snapshot is preserved as provenance context.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local material reports structure, stereochemistry, biosynthetic context, and antimicrobial phenotype, but no direct antimicrobial target/mechanism assay.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Mechanism layer records biosynthetic/phenotypic context only and does not overclaim direct mechanism.
